title: SDLC Work Item Requirements v1
description: The current normalized requirements and acceptance criteria for one work item, grouped by the globally qualified source object that established each requirement.
$comment: The requirements map is the mutable current projection for a work item. Each key is the sole provenance identity for the requirements in its array. Host validation must enforce uniqueness of requirement and acceptance-criterion IDs across all arrays, verify that each acceptance-criterion ID belongs to its containing requirement, resolve source-object references, and prevent conflicting duplicate IDs.

requirements.description: Map from a globally qualified source-object reference to the requirements established by that source. The source key is the sole provenance field for the mapped requirements.
